1.DisplayText: I'm starving, so I'm going all in! I'm publicly exposing Mezoth for withholding employee benefits and abusing his power!
1.Message1: Brave move, but be careful! I heard he's the CEO's brother-in-law...
1.Message2: Attention, everyone! The HR department is taking this matter seriously. We vow to uphold the rights of all frontline employees!

2.DisplayText: Who understands a designer's pain? One word from the boss, and we have to scrap everything and start over! It's absolutely soul crushing!
2.Message1: Stop, I'm on the verge of tears! This is my ninth revision, and I'm not sure I'll even make it to tomorrow...
2.Message2: No wonder the Design Department's job listing says "Graveborn preferred." At least we won't die from exhaustion.

3.DisplayText:
[AD] Feeling unmotivated? Tired of clueless leadership? Join the Corporate Culture Department—we're always hiring!
Ready to reinvent yourself and reach new heights?
Apply now!
3.Message1: Corporate Culture promises great perks—satisfaction guaranteed! (Feel free to tweak the wording, don't just copy-paste.)
3.Message2: [Banned] A recent investigation uncovered a batch of suspicious recruitment letters. It turns out it was all a Hypogean's trick.

4.DisplayText: That streak in the sky isn't a shooting star...it's me. And I'm a marketing firecracker like no other.
4.Message1: The scariest phrase I hear every day: "Team Leader, bring me my Hypogean cannon!"
4.Message2: Shooting people out of a cannon may be an unreasonable punishment, but I can't deny it... I'm hooked on the thrill.

5.DisplayText: [Trending] Timed bathroom breaks? The Efficiency Department's new rule sparks controversy. Should paid restroom breaks be restricted?
5.Message1: Can someone confirm if this is real? I just applied to that department...
5.Message2: It's real. A friend of mine got blown up for going over their bathroom time limit... and they're still recovering.

6.DisplayText: We demand justice! The Head of HR is a liar! Unpaid wages, broken promises - everything we were told was a scam!
6.Message1: Colleagues who want to join the wage protest group, contact me.
6.Message2: I thought he was a good guy! He swore he'd help the security team fight for what's right, but it turns out...

7.DisplayText: Three years in, I've lost six bones to the cold! This heartless company doesn't care about anyone... If we workers want our freedom, we must resist!
7.Message1: Hmph! Once you sit in my chair, you'll understand. One day, you'll become exactly what you hate.
7.Message2: I've been reading these posts for days... Your company isn't about to go under, is it? Pay me last year's balance first!
